newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens wins 330 mln DM Philippine deal.
newsitem.headline: Siemens wins 330 mln DM Philippine deal.

text.p: German industrial group Siemens AG said on Thursday its public networking unit (ON) won a 330 million mark contract for a telephone network in the Philippines.
ON would install 20,000 wireles phone lines over the next ten weeks and 160,000 phone connections by the end of the year for private Philippine operator Islacom, Siemens said.
The company expected to install 350,000 more lines over the next several years.

The wireless portion of the network would provide service to the cities of Bacolod, Iloilo and Tacloban using systems based on the digital enhanced cordless telecommunications (DECT) standard. Siemens would manufacture the DECT equipment in Greifswald, the company said.
Islacom is a consortium whose partners include Deutsche Telekom AG and Thailand's major telecom group Shinawatra Computer and Communication Plc.
